newsitem.title: UK: European VGO takes crude support, some head to U.S.
newsitem.headline: European VGO takes crude support, some head to U.S.

text.p: European vacuum gas was a touch firmer on Wednesday, taking most support from stronger crude and U.S interest.
Traders said there had been little activity following on from a deal concluded on Monday at around $162-163 fob NWE for a 40,000 tonne low sulphur cargo loading December 13-17.
"Its likely to be headed to the U.S. because the arb is there," said one trader. Further transatlantic trade was being hampered by lack of supplies.
A Scandinavia seller may have a cargo but another seller was not expected to have any fresh supplies before January.
On the high sulphur VGO market requirement for December material was limited with at least one big buyer claiming to be out of the running for product until January.
